_comment: S8HN -- High-N Realistic Band Scene. A copy of s8-band-scene.json with id S8HN and trials raised from 5 to 25, built for C-ASYM-A Part C (qa/rr-study/2026-08-23-0959-architect-to-qa-spec-c-asym-a-decode-set-asymmetry.md Sec.4.3). At the standing S8's N=5 (60 decodes/appraiser) the 95% half-width on M_syn is ~0.07 against a 0.10 gate bar -- not resolvable (HK-021(m)). 12 stations x 25 trials = 300 injected messages/appraiser, half-width ~0.034 at M_syn=0.10. Deliberately NOT a modification of s8-band-scene.json or S8's registry entry -- the ratified study is left exactly as it is -- and deliberately NOT added to run_study.py's _CONTROLLED_SCENARIO_IDS (reached only via --scenarios S8HN, like S3b).
name: Realistic Band Scene -- High-N (C-ASYM-A Part C)
description: Fixed 12-station band profile across 450-2550 Hz at realistic SNR spread (-15 to +3 dB), identical signal set to S8. Includes a near-collision pair (E/F, 12 Hz apart) and a capture pair (G/H, co-frequency, 6 dB ratio). 25 trials vary only AWGN seed. Metric: M_syn (the D-001 statistic computed where injected truth is known) side by side with recovery_ours / recovery_theirs -- gated per C-ASYM-A Sec.5 Gate C.

signals._note: Near-collision with E: 12 Hz apart (< 2 tone bins). Report separately per Sec.4.3 -- exclude from M_syn's primary denominator, report both ways.
Capture pair with G: co-frequency, 6 dB weaker
0.5 s late start -- exercises time-offset separation
